title: 对亚洲母亲无所不能的刻板印象(1)
desc: 对亚洲母亲无所不能的刻板印象(1)

paragraphs.en: In January 2011, the English-speaking world was introduced to a new kind of villain.
paragraphs.zh: 2011年1月，英语世界认识了一类全新的反派形象。

paragraphs.en: She arrived in the form of a viral Wall Street Journal article with the headline "Why Chinese mothers are superior".
paragraphs.zh: 这一形象源自一篇引爆网络的《华尔街日报》文章，标题为《为什么中国母亲更优秀》。

paragraphs.en: The author, a relatively unknown Yale law professor named Amy Chua, outlined her strict rules for her two daughters: no sleepovers, playdates or school plays – and no complaining about not being in the school play, either.
paragraphs.zh: 文章作者是当时名气不大的耶鲁大学法学教授蔡美儿，她列出了对两个女儿定下的严苛家规：不许在外过夜、不许参加玩伴聚会、不许参演校园戏剧——就连抱怨没能参演校园戏剧也不行。

paragraphs.en: They were expected to be the top students in all subjects at school (except gym and drama).
paragraphs.zh: 她要求女儿在校所有科目都必须名列前茅（体育和戏剧课除外）。

paragraphs.en: When her seven-year-old refused to play a song on the piano, Chua threatened her with no lunch, no dinner and no birthday parties for four years until she complied.
paragraphs.zh: 七岁的小女儿不肯弹奏一首钢琴曲时，蔡美儿威胁，要是不乖乖照做，就连续四年不给她午饭、晚饭，也不让她办生日派对。

paragraphs.en: Another time, after the same daughter misbehaved, Chua branded her "garbage".
paragraphs.zh: 还有一次，同样是这个女儿调皮犯错，蔡美儿骂她是“垃圾”。

paragraphs.en: The backlash was swift and vicious. Chua was called an abuser, a stereotype peddler, a shock jock.
paragraphs.zh: 反对声浪迅速袭来，言辞激烈。蔡美儿被称作施虐者、贩卖刻板印象的人、博眼球的言论狂人。

paragraphs.en: The article was an extract from her memoir, Battle Hymn of the Tiger Mother, and Chua did her best to explain that, in the book, she reckons with the limits of her parenting.
paragraphs.zh: 这篇文章节选自她的回忆录《虎妈战歌》，蔡美儿尽力解释，在书中她反思了自己这套育儿方式的局限。

paragraphs.en: But it was too late: the controversy had taken on a life of its own.
paragraphs.zh: 但为时已晚：这场争议已经脱离了她的掌控，自行发酵。

paragraphs.en: Many Asian American writers responded by sharing their ambivalence or anger about having been raised in this way.
paragraphs.zh: 许多亚裔美国作家撰文回应，讲述自己在这种教育方式下长大的复杂感受或是满腔怒火。

paragraphs.en: "I grew up with a tiger parent and all I got was this lousy psychological trauma" declared one such blog post.
paragraphs.zh: 有一篇博客这样写道：“我在虎爸虎妈的管教下长大，到头来只落下这糟糕的心理创伤。”

paragraphs.en: Suddenly a ubiquitous but private dynamic was being held up for public debate.
paragraphs.zh: 一瞬间，这种普遍存在却只发生在家庭内部的相处模式，被推到公众面前讨论。

paragraphs.en: There were endless letters, op-eds, blogs, tweets, Facebook posts.
paragraphs.zh: 相关的读者来信、评论专栏、博客、推特帖子、脸书帖子层出不穷。

paragraphs.en: My grandparents in China, who are as removed from the American commentariat as one could possibly be, asked me about the American lady boasting about getting her kids into Harvard and giving Chinese people a bad name.
paragraphs.zh: 我在中国的祖父母，几乎完全不了解美国评论界，却也来问我，那个美国女人吹嘘把孩子送进哈佛，给中国人抹了黑是怎么回事。

paragraphs.en: Reading Chua's memoir recently, I was struck by its unapologetic and breezy tone, which feels like an artefact of its time; writers today, keenly attuned to the risks of viral attention, are more cautious.
paragraphs.zh: 最近重读蔡美儿的这本回忆录，我被书中毫无歉意、轻松随意的语气惊到，这种文风如同一件时代遗物；如今的写作者深知 肆意传播的热度带来的风险，下笔会更加谨慎。

paragraphs.en: Yet despite its singular infamy, Chua's book is part of a rich tradition of books and films from the east and south-east Asian diaspora that examine complicated mother-and-daughter relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 然而尽管这本书声名狼藉，它只是东亚和东南亚移民群体众多文学、影视作品中的一部，这类作品都在探讨复杂的母女关系。

paragraphs.en: Two of the seminal Chinese American novels – Maxine Hong Kingston's The Woman Warrior and Amy Tan's The Joy Luck Club – are structured around conversations, real and imagined, between mother-and-daughter pairings.
paragraphs.zh: 两部具有里程碑意义的华裔美国小说——汤亭亭的《女勇士》与谭恩美的《喜福会》，都以母女之间真实与想象中的对话作为叙事主线。

paragraphs.en: A seminal work of Chinese-British nonfiction, Jung Chang's Wild Swans, tells the convulsive history of modern China through the lives of Chang's mother and grandmother – and was followed by the memoir Fly, Wild Swans, an intimate and pained love letter to the author's own mother.
paragraphs.zh: 张戎的《鸿》是英籍华裔纪实文学的经典之作，借由作者母亲与外祖母的人生，讲述跌宕起伏的现代中国历史；之后又有回忆录《鸿雁，展翅》，这是写给作者母亲饱含痛楚、深情款款的私人告白。

paragraphs.en: In these works, the mother has a way of emerging as the primordial wound: one to be constantly picked at, never healed.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些作品里，母亲往往是一道原始的创伤：一道总被反复触碰、永远无法愈合的伤口。

paragraphs.en: It continues in cinema: the 2018 box office hit Crazy Rich Asians has at its heart not a tension between the main couple, but rather that between its Chinese American protagonist and her boyfriend's aloof Singaporean mother, played by Michelle Yeoh.
paragraphs.zh: 电影领域同样延续这一主题：2018年票房爆款《摘金奇缘》的核心矛盾，并非主角情侣之间的隔阂，而是华裔美国女主角与男友那位冷漠的新加坡母亲之间的冲突，该角色由杨紫琼饰演。

paragraphs.en: Yeoh is once again a difficult mother in the 2022 Oscar-winning film Everything Everywhere All at Once, this time as a frazzled first-generation immigrant to the US who (literally) runs to the ends of the earth to reconcile with her queer daughter.
paragraphs.zh: 在2022年斩获奥斯卡大奖的《瞬息全宇宙》中，杨紫琼再次饰演一位难相处的母亲，这次她是心力交瘁的第一代赴美移民，走遍天涯，只为和身为性少数群体的女儿和解。

paragraphs.en: The same year Pixar released Turning Red, which follows a Chinese Canadian teenager running away from her overbearing mum.
paragraphs.zh: 同年，皮克斯推出《青春变形记》，故事讲述一名加拿大华裔少女逃离强势母亲的故事。

paragraphs.en: These mothers do not have the vaudeville villainy of Chua's tiger mother.
paragraphs.zh: 这些母亲，并不像蔡美儿笔下的虎妈那样，是滑稽戏里脸谱化的恶人。

paragraphs.en: And yet they, too, are often strict and difficult to please; cold and prone to bouts of explosive anger; inscrutable and marked by grief.
paragraphs.zh: 但她们往往同样严厉、难以取悦，性格冷淡，动辄暴怒，心思难以捉摸，内心背负伤痛。

paragraphs.en: "For most of my childhood and adolescence, my mother was my antagonist," recalls the narrator in Ling Ma's widely lauded novel Severance.
paragraphs.zh: 在马凌广受好评的小说《幸福蒙太奇》中，叙述者回忆道：“在童年和青春期的大部分时光里，我的母亲是我的对手。”

paragraphs.en: The British Chinese poet Sarah Howe's collection Foretokens, inspired by her mother's life in communist China, includes the very funny A History of My Relationship With My Mother in 23 Arguments About the Laundry.
paragraphs.zh: 英籍华裔诗人萨拉·豪的诗集《预兆》灵感来源于母亲在中国的人生经历，其中收录了一篇非常有趣的作品《我与母亲的关系，写在23次关于洗衣的争吵里》。

paragraphs.en: ("I sought to illustrate to her that putting more than one towel in at once would not result in disaster, flood, famine.")
paragraphs.zh: （“我试图向她说明，一次放多条毛巾进洗衣机，并不会引发灾难、洪水与饥荒。”）

paragraphs.en: Not long ago, I picked up Gish Jen's new memoir-novel Bad Bad Girl, which is inspired by her mother's childhood in war-torn Shanghai.
paragraphs.zh: 不久前，我读了任璧莲新出版的回忆录式小说《坏坏女孩》，这本书取材于她母亲在战火纷飞的上海度过的童年。

paragraphs.en: The title takes its name from the admonishment Jen imagines her mother issuing to her from beyond the grave for writing so publicly about private grievances.
paragraphs.zh: 书名来自任璧莲想象中，母亲在离世后对她的斥责——指责她将家庭私怨公之于众。

paragraphs.en: (A satirical cartoon about Asian American cinema describes the genre's themes in six words: "There's this mom. And she's bad.")
paragraphs.zh: （有一张讽刺亚裔美国电影的漫画，用这句话概括这类作品的主题：“有这么一位母亲。她很糟糕。”）
